utterance: Which confidential support service can Alderbridge staff use for personal worries, and how can they reach it?
answer:
Alderbridge staff can use the Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), a confidential, externally provided counselling and support service available to every employee; the EAP offers telephone counselling and self‑help resources and may be accessed directly, confidentially and free of charge at any time regardless of the reason. In addition, staff may speak directly and confidentially to their site’s mental health first aider (listed on the staff noticeboard), and a line manager may make a wellbeing referral to occupational health where attendance or performance appears affected by a health condition (with the employee’s consent except where an immediate safeguarding concern requires escalation).
